inlines.v: RE-ECH'O, verb intransitive [re and echo.] To echo back; to reverberate again; as, the hills re-echo the roar of cannon. RE-ECH'O, verb intransitive [supra.] To echo back; to return back or be reverberated; as an echo. And a loud groan re-echoes from the main. RE-ECH'O, noun The echo of an echo.
